jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* 2 years of experience developing or launching infrastructure products or technologies within networking, storage, compute hardware, databases, file systems, data analytics, cluster management, or other software infrastructure areas.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in product management, including providing product goal, strategy development, data\-influenced product planning, prioritization and directing product launches from conception through launch with a focus on enterprise software or cloud services.
* Deep understanding of the identity, abuse and fraud risk detection space, and proven track record of successfully launching and managing enterprise software products.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable product plans.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


As a Product Manager for KYC and Identity Verification, you will be a catalyst for change in the realm of digital identity, redefining how businesses grow, innovate, and comply online. Your mission is to build a reusable identity layer that unlocks seamless onboarding experiences while maintaining global compliance integrity and combating fraud at scale. You will sit at the intersection of platform and product experience, defining the primitives and standards that make identity verification privacy\-conscious and globally compliant. You will leverage your domain knowledge and product expertise to develop comprehensive, end\-to\-end sales processes. Your primary objective will be to facilitate the scalability of the Cloud business.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Operate with customer empathy and put yourself in users shoes all the time. Work cross\-functionally and partner closely with engineering and business organizations.
* Set the roadmap, gather requirements, identify risks, and work with all the stakeholders to deliver a performant and reliable identity management for Google Cloud customers.
* Launch new products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly. Drive positioning and launch strategy for our solutions.
* Develop innovative solutions to hard problems by collaborating as needed across regions, areas, and functions.
* Understand how users and customers derive value from Cloud business platform solutions, establishing domain expertise inside and outside Google on customer use cases and requirements.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About YAL.ai and Discovery**  

YAL is building Discovery — an intent\-driven social platform that connects people through situation\-based matching. We help people find the one specific person who has been in their exact situation and can actually help. We are launching across IITs, IIMs, and top campuses in India. The team is 15 people, the product is launching in 18 days, and the work is real from day one. **The Role**  

You will work directly with the product lead and own the operational product layer that makes execution possible — research synthesis, engineering coordination, design review, EIR programme intelligence, and user feedback triage. You are not managing people. You are making sure the right information gets to the right person at the right time so that decisions happen fast and well. **What You Will Do** **Product intelligence and research*** Own the EIR product intelligence system — read conversation notes coming in from 22 campuses, run the extraction pipeline, identify patterns, and deliver a weekly synthesised report to the product lead.
* Audit research quality — identify when EIR conversations have sampling bias, leading questions, or weak methodology before that data reaches product decisions.
* Cross\-check qualitative interview findings against survey data and produce a reconciled picture of what users actually want versus what they say they want.
* Turn research into product recommendations with evidence attached — not summaries, decisions.

 **Engineering coordination*** Attend daily standups across all engineering teams, summarise, flag blockers, and escalate only what genuinely needs the product lead.
* Own minor product decisions within defined boundaries. Make the call and document it. Escalate the ones that require strategy.
* Track sprint progress and surface risks before they become blockers.

 **Design review*** Own the weekly design review loop — check UI/UX decisions against PRD specs, flag deviations, write clear actionable feedback in writing.

 **User feedback — post launch*** Triage all incoming user feedback — categorise by type and severity, prioritise against the roadmap, and deliver a weekly prioritised list.
* Run structured feedback sessions with EIRs and early users on a standing weekly cadence.

 **What We Are Looking For** **Must have*** 0 to 2 years of experience in a product, research, or early\-stage operator role where you had no playbook and had to figure it out.
* You have done real user research — run interviews, synthesised findings, made a product recommendation from them. You can read a conversation note and tell immediately whether the methodology was right or wrong.
* You write clearly and specifically. A brief from you should not need editing before an engineer acts on it.
* You are comfortable not knowing what to work on next and figuring it out yourself.
* You have worked with or alongside a technical team and can translate between product intent and engineering constraint.
* Familiarity with the IIT or top college ecosystem as a student, graduate, or someone who has worked closely within it.

 **Nice to have**  

* Experience synthesising large volumes of qualitative research and finding non\-obvious patterns.
* Prior exposure to a consumer social or community product at an early stage.

 **What This Is Not**  

This is not a structured rotation. The scope expands every week as the product grows. If you need a clean job description to know what to work on each day, this is not the right fit. If your instinct when you see a problem is to understand it fully and act on it, keep reading. **What You Get**  

* Direct access to the product lead and the full founding team from week one.
* Real ownership of the product intelligence and operational layer at the most consequential stage of the company.
* Competitive salary.
* Work on a product that measures success in real connections between real people, not vanity metrics.

* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.

**Job Description and Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Launch Manager to lead strategic product launches across our Generics and Consumer Health portfolio.
   

  

 You will take full ownership of the launch lifecycle, from planning to execution to closure, ensuring that launches are delivered on time, aligned with business decisions, and optimized for value.

* Strong leadership skills, with the ability to inspire, challenge, and align stakeholders toward shared goals.

 Orion Pharma is a globally operating Nordic pharmaceutical company – a builder of well\-being for over a hundred years.
   

  

 We’re home to more than 4,000 Orionees around the world, and we’re proud to be known as a responsible employer and a great place to work. At Orion Pharma, people are truly valued and trusted, encouraged to grow, and supported by a culture where every voice is heard.  We operate in a fast‑paced R\&D culture that values experimentation, modern technologies, and a blend of experienced and early‑career engineers who are passionate about building world‑class security products.
 



  





**About the Position** 




 We are building a next‑generation cloud security platform used at scale across our customer environments. As part of this mission, we are expanding our
 **Vulnerability Management (VM)** 
 team responsible for securing cloud, Kubernetes, and containerized infrastructure.
 



 As a
 **Senior/Principal Product Manager for Vulnerability Management** 
 , you will lead the evolution of Aqua’s scanning, detection, and exposure‑management capabilities. You will shape product vision, define strategy, and guide execution for the systems that detect, analyze, prioritize, and reduce risk in modern cloud‑native environments.
 



 You will influence the future of the VM industry by blending technical depth, strong product instincts, and customer empathy to deliver innovative solutions that help enterprises understand and reduce real risk—not just vulnerability noise.
 



**Working from Aqua Hyderabad office a minimum of 4 days per week (Mon\-Thu)** 




  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Product Strategy \& Vision** 



* Define, articulate, and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Vulnerability Management, aligned with business and customer outcomes.
* Develop a forward‑looking strategy for how VM evolves across cloud, Kubernetes, serverless, and container ecosystems.
* Analyze and define attack paths and exposure chains that connect vulnerabilities to critical assets (“crown jewels”), enabling intelligent risk‑based prioritization.



**Execution \& Cross‑Functional Leadership** 



* Collaborate proactively with engineering, design, architecture, and security research teams to deliver high‑impact capabilities at scale.
* Translate complex technical challenges into clear product requirements and prioritization trade‑offs.
* Partner closely with engineering leadership to solve deep technical problems and ensure high‑quality, on‑time releases.



**Customer, Market \& Ecosystem Leadership** 



* Stay ahead of trends in VM, CNAPP, cloud workloads, and attacker behaviour.
* Represent Aqua as a thought leader in vulnerability and exposure management—engaging customers, prospects, partners, and industry analysts.
* Regularly collect and internalize customer feedback to refine product direction and adoption.



**Go‑to‑Market \& Business Leadership** 



* Own the product roadmap narrative and communicate prioritization, rationale, and outcomes across stakeholders.
* Partner with Product Marketing to craft differentiated messaging, positioning, and sales enablement content.
* Develop pricing, packaging, and GTM strategies to maximize adoption and revenue.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field. with minimum
 **18\+ years experience and** 
**9\+ years of product management experience** 
 .
* Demonstrated experience building
 **enterprise SaaS, security, cloud, or vulnerability management products** 
 .
* Strong cloud‑security knowledge—expertise in
 **AWS, Azure, or GCP** 
 , including networking, IAM, Kubernetes, and/or serverless.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams, executives, and customers.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to use data to guide decisions.
* Highly self‑driven with a track record of executing in fast‑moving environments.
* Ability to influence, align, and collaborate across functions without direct authority.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* MBA or advanced degree in a relevant field.
* Experience with cloud‑native security platforms (CNAPP, CSPM, CIEM, CWPP).
* Prior experience building or launching enterprise vulnerability management solutions.
* Experience working with large‑scale security data, signal quality, false positives, and prioritization frameworks.



 If you’re ready for an exciting opportunity to dive into the hottest cybersecurity category, now is the perfect time to join Aqua! We are a global organization where every Aquarian can make a difference and make a big impact. Aqua also offers great company culture, amazing colleagues, international travel, and lots more!
 



 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Specialist, Data Quality Stewardship
jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.


Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  

Role Overview
  
The Specialist, Data Quality Stewardship is part of the EDQDSC (Enterprise Data Quality and Data Stewardship) team within the CDAO (Chief Data and Analytics Office). This role plays a pivotal part in ensuring the data quality across multiple domains and divisions, directly supporting business outcomes and ultimately impacting patients who rely on life\-saving products.
  
This is a global role supporting data domains and divisions across thepharma value chain. The Specialist works closely with business, data owners, data enablement teams, and IT stakeholders to define data quality standards, monitor data issues, drive root\-cause analysis, and support remediation activities. The role also identifies opportunities forautomation and innovation to improve data quality monitoring, controls, and issue resolution processes.
  
  

What will you do in this role
  
Data Quality Platform Onboarding, Adoption and Enablement
  
  

* Work with divisional partners to onboard their data to the enterprise data quality platform.
* Support adoption of the platform within business teams and promote consistent usage.
* Understand divisional requirements and configure and implement them within the data quality platform.
* Serve as a liaison between business data owners, IT, and the CDAO to ensure alignment on data quality priorities.
* Train users on the data quality platform and encourage consistent, effective usage.
* Contribute to the development and documentation of platform standards, operating procedures, and best practices.
* Maintain accurate and high\-quality documentation of processes, rules, and controls.


Data Quality Rule Development and Management
  
  

* Create, maintain, and enhance data quality rules and checks.
* Develop and execute data quality routines, validations, and monitoring controls.
* Partner within CDAO teams to align data quality rules with enterprise data policies and standards.


•
  
  

Data Quality Metrics, Reporting KPIs
  
  

* Define, measure, and report on data quality KPIs (e.g., completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency etc.) across domains.
* Develop and maintain data quality dashboards and scorecards for leadership visibility.
* Track trends and provide insights to drive prioritization of data quality improvement initiatives.


Data Quality Monitoring and Issue Management
  
  

* Review data quality reports and identify issues, trends, anomalies and opportunities for improvement.
* Investigate data quality issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and coordinate remediation with relevant stakeholders.
* Communicate findings clearly with divisional stakeholders and support remediation efforts.
* Facilitate data quality issue resolution discussions with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Maintain a data quality issue log, track resolution progress, and ensure timely closure.
* Define and follow escalation paths for critical data quality issues impacting downstream processes.
* Support adherence to SLAs for data quality issue resolution.
* Ensure data quality practices align with regulatory requirements and documentation (e.g., GxP, FDA, EMA) where applicable.
* Support audit readiness by maintaining traceability of data quality rules, controls, and remediation actions.


Automation, Innovation and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Contribute innovative ideas to improve data quality management processes, controls, and user experience.
* Develop automation utilities to improve monitoring, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Apply analytical thinking and problem\-solving to resolve complex data issues.
* Promote a culture of data quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.


•
  
  

What should you have
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5 years of experience in data quality, or related technology roles.
* StrongSQL skills are essential.
* Experience withdata profiling, issue management, and root\-causeanalysis.
* Familiarity with master data management, reference data, and metadata concepts.
* Experience with data transformation routines, including ETL/ELT processes.
* Familiarity with medallion architecture and cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake,Databricks).
* Experience and knowledge on API integration and Airflow.
* Familiarity with …

We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Developer with 6\+ years of software development experience to design, develop, and deliver scalable software applications using modern web, backend, and database technologies. * Experience consuming and integrating RESTful APIs.

-----------

* Strong hands\-on experience with Python for backend development, API development, scripting, or automation.

* Strong understanding of REST API design, integration, error handling, and security.
* Knowledge of authentication, authorization, logging, and secure coding practices.

**Database**
------------

* Strong knowledge of Oracle Database.
* Strong SQL skills for querying, joins, data validation, and performance tuning.
* Understanding of database design, stored procedures, indexing, and optimization concepts.
* Ability to troubleshoot application and database integration issues.

**Tools \& Practices**
----------------------

* Git / Version Control.
* Agile / Scrum methodology.
* CI/CD pipeline awareness.
* Code review and quality assurance practices.
* Application debugging, logging, and performance monitoring.
* Ability to guide development teams on coding standards and best practices.

**Nice to Have**
================

* Experience with Oracle APEX.
* Experience evaluating and guiding the responsible use of AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, or LLM\-based IDE extensions for code generation, review, refactoring, documentation, and testing.
* Experience modernizing or migrating from legacy platforms (including Oracle APEX or similar low\-code systems).
* Exposure to cloud platforms.
* Experience leading technical design discussions.
* Knowledge of enterprise application architecture.
  

**Qualifications*** Minimum 6\+ years of relevant software development experience.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Self\-organizing, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
* A mindset oriented toward progress, modernization, and continuous improvement.

At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. jobs.title: Senior Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WS Audiology continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**


We are looking for a **Senior Systems Analyst** to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and the Data Platform \& Products Team. In this role, you will translate analytical, operational, and regulatory requirements into governed, trusted data products, standardized KPIs, and high\-quality data assets. You will play a key role in ensuring that data products are discoverable, well\-documented, compliant, and aligned with business needs across the organization.

**What you will do**
--------------------

### **Requirements Gathering \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Collaborate with stakeholders across Marketing Analytics, Product, Regulatory, Support, and Business teams to gather, analyze, and document business requirements.
* Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, and review meetings to align business objectives with technical delivery.
* Translate business needs into clear data product specifications and functional requirements for Data Engineers and Architects.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the Data Platform team.

### **Data Products \& KPI Management**

* Define and maintain business KPIs, metric definitions, and calculation logic to ensure consistent reporting across the organization.
* Author and maintain data contracts, business glossaries, data dictionaries, and metadata documentation.
* Support the creation, certification, and publishing of trusted data products and analytical datasets.
* Promote standardization of business metrics and reporting practices across teams.

### **Governance \& Compliance**

* Support implementation of data governance policies, standards, and best practices.
* Maintain metadata, lineage, and business classifications within Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog.
* Ensure data assets remain compliant with governance, audit, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Champion data stewardship and data ownership practices across the organization.

### **Data Validation \& Acceptance Testing**

* Validate data products and pipeline outputs against business and technical requirements.
* Participate in acceptance testing activities and certify data products before business consumption.
* Investigate data quality issues and coordinate resolution with Data Engineers and Architects.
* Analyze data quality trends and recommend improvements to increase trust and usability.

### **Documentation \& Adoption**

* Produce and maintain functional specifications, governance documentation, data dictionaries, and user guidance materials.
* Promote adoption of certified data products across business teams.
* Ensure data catalogs and documentation remain accurate, accessible, and understandable for non\-technical users.
* Drive awareness of available data assets and their business value.

**What you bring**
------------------

### **Experience**

* 5\+ years of experience in Systems Analysis, Business Analysis, Data Analysis, or Data Governance.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience working with analytics, reporting, or enterprise data platforms.
* Proven experience facilitating requirements sessions and engaging with diverse business stakeholders.
* Exposure to data governance, metadata management, compliance reporting, or regulatory environments.

### **Technical Skills**

* Strong SQL skills for data validation, analysis, and requirements verification.
* Experience authoring and maintaining data contracts and metadata documentation.
* Familiarity with Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview, and data governance practices.
* Understanding of Power BI reporting concepts and data product consumption.
* Awareness of Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and observability concepts.
* Basic familiarity with Databricks notebooks and data platform workflows.
* Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, data lineage, and data quality frameworks.

### **Personal Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent requirements gathering, documentation, and communication abilities.
* Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to translate ambiguity into clear, actionable requirements.
* Passion for data quality, governance, and enabling data\-driven decision\-making.
* Ability to work effectively across technical and non\-technical teams in a global environment.

**Who we are**
--------------


At WS Audiology, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.


Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.


With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

**Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**


WS Audiology is an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e\-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers \- ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.
We are driven by a ‘user\-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ \& delivery \- not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager 2 who is passionate about solving high\-impact problems in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross\-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
### **What you will do**

* Market \& Customer Understanding: Understand the e\-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification \& Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology\-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross\-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go\-to\-Market Planning: Create a go\-to\-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption \& Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3\-month forward\-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 4\+ yrs with at least 2\+ yrs in product management in a tech\-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills based on the first principles of thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.


**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor \- our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**


### **Our Mission**



Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e\-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.



We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state\-of\-the\-art tech infrastructure, and pan\-India logistics network through trusted third\-party partners.



Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi\-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e\-commerce ecosystem.


### **Culture and Total Rewards**



Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people\-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.



Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non\-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.



We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity\-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee\-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness\-related perks.

**Morgan Stanley**

**Java developer \- Vice President \- Software Engineering**

**Profile Description**

We’re seeking someone to join our FRPPE Tech team as JAVA Developer/Technical Manager position for Operations Technology Team to develop Core Platform Services to help drive program automation and strategy.


**Super Department**  



The Operations Technology division is responsible for building and operating the technology platform catering to critical business processes at Morgan Stanley including Settlements, Regulatory Reporting, Client Reference Data, Position Keeping, Corporate Actions processing and other post\-trade functions. The Firm operates at scale with up to 40 million trades processed on peak volume days and hundreds of billions of dollars of daily settlements with activity ongoing in multiple countries and currencies across the globe.


There is a great breadth of financial products that our Operations plant handles across equity and fixed income, from cash products to complex derivatives and loans.  

  



**Department**  



Transaction Reporting, part of Operations Technology, is responsible for building scalable solutions to meet the Firm's trade reporting commitments. This is a 24x5 system, receiving real\-time feeds from different trade booking systems across Listed Cash, Listed Derivatives and OTC Derivatives. Our systems consume these feeds and generate reports according to the regulatory specifications defined by each country involved in the trade. The challenge is both functional, to understand complex trade bookings and generate trade reports, as well as technical, to meet the strict time deadlines imposed by regulators while handling massive amount of data across the Firm.


In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities.


This is a Lead Software Engineer, which is part of the job family responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions that support business needs.


Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.


**What you’ll do in the role:**

* You are required to be a technologist with solid command on distributed development tools and tech\-stack \- primarily Java and Java\-based web development, Angular, databases, frameworks for enterprise system development, enterprise integration patterns, cloud\-focused architecture and tools.
* You will be owning the development on new platform as per established best practices, adhering to standards set up by the group and with diligent focus on Usability, Cloud Adoption and User Experience.
* Role involves broad engagement with our wide user base, distributed across the globe to come up with effective user interface for our onboarding and regulatory platform.
* You will be involved with every facet of software development, from requirement analysis, design and development to helping the team continuously improve its agile development practices.

**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* Strong Senior Technologist with 10\+ years of career experience and advanced knowledge on Java and Java\-based technology stack.
* At least 10 years relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role.
* Experience with web service development, REST and Service\-Oriented Architecture.
* Expertise in Object\-Oriented Design, Design patterns, Architecture and Application Integration.
* Working knowledge of Databases including Design and SQL proficiency.
* Strong experience with frameworks used for development and automated testing like Spring, JUnit, BDD etc.
* Experience with Unix/Linux.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple groups, both internal and external to the firm, including offshore development and QA teams, internal infrastructure groups, vendors, and support teams.
* Strong development skills with ability to understand technical design and translate the same into workable solution.
* Familiarity with working in a large team.
* Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and work on the same to meet business requirements.
* A background that includes strong problem solving such as system integration, infrastructure debugging, or system administration.
* Experience in effectively executing IT strategy, delivery and complex initiatives.
* Ability to present information in a clear and concise manner to technology and business leadership.
* Advanced understanding of functional area and competent understanding of competitive environment.

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

The Product team forms the crux of our powerful platforms and helps connect millions of customers worldwide with the brands that matter most to them. This team of innovative problem solvers develops and builds products that position Epsilon as a differentiator, encouraging an open and balanced marketplace built on respect for individuals, where every brand interaction holds value. **Why are we looking for you?**  

At Epsilon, we run on our people's ideas. It's how we solve problems and exceed expectations. Our team is now growing, and we are on the lookout for dedicated individuals who always set the standard by constantly challenging themselves and are experts in building customized solutions in the digital marketing space. jobs.description:
**Dreaming big is in our DNA. It’s who we are as a company. It’s our culture. It’s our heritage. And more than ever, it’s our future. A future where we’re always looking forward. Always serving up new ways to meet life’s moments. A future where we keep dreaming bigger. We look for people with passion, talent, and curiosity, and provide them with the teammates, resources and opportunities to unleash their full potential. The power we create together – when we combine your strengths with ours – is unstoppable. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?** 




  





  





*AB InBev GCC was incorporated in 2014 as a strategic partner for Anheuser\-Busch InBev. The center leverages the power of data and analytics to drive growth for critical business functions such as operations, finance, people, and technology. The teams are transforming Operations through Tech and Analytics.* 




  





*Do You Dream Big?* 




*We Need You.* 




  





**Job Description** 




**Job Title:** 
 Product Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**PURPOSE OF ROLE** 




 BrewDat is ABI’s data platform, powering data products and AI solutions across all our domains – from sales and marketing to supply, finance, people, and more.
 



  





 We provide the data foundations, frameworks, and tools that enable teams across ABI to ingest, transform, govern, and serve data at scale \- following Data Mesh and Domain\-Driven Design principles.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong technical background to lead the Integration products of BrewDat.
 



 Your main mission is to:
 


* Build and evolve the vision, strategy, and roadmap for BrewDat’s data engineering capabilities (ingestion, transformation, and serving).
* Understand and prioritize user needs from data engineers, analytics engineers, ML engineers, and domain teams.
* Turn complex platform capabilities into clear, usable products that make data teams more productive and autonomous.
* Build our Integration\-as\-a\-Service platform and guide the transition from legacy middleware to cloud\-native architectures



  





 You’ll work in a cross\-functional squad alongside engineers, a Delivery Manager, architects, and governance specialists, and you’ll collaborate closely with the Adoption team, who bring users’ needs to the product area.
 



  





**KEY TASKS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES** 



* **Product Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and evolve the product vision for BrewDat's data engineering layer (ingestion, transformation, and serving).
* Translate company and data strategy into a clear, prioritized roadmap for your squad.
* **Discovery \& User\-Centricity**
* Deeply understand the needs of data engineers, analytics engineers, domain squads, and internal platform users.
* Run product discovery: interviews, usage analysis, experiments, and feedback loops with internal customers.
* **Roadmap \& Delivery**
* Own and manage the product backlog for the Data Engineering squad.
* Write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, focusing on outcomes rather than outputs.
* Work in an Agile environment, participating in ceremonies and ensuring alignment between Product, Engineering, and Architecture.
* **Measurement \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track product KPIs: adoption, CSAT from users, build times, time\-to\-data, platform reliability, etc.
* Use data and feedback to continuously refine priorities and validate if shipped features are creating value.
* Promote a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement within the squad.
* **Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Align with multiple stakeholders (domains like sales, marketing, supply, finance, tech, etc.).
* Communicate roadmap, progress, trade\-offs, and impact clearly and frequently.
* Partner with the Adoption team to launch new capabilities, manage change, and scale usage.
* **Middleware**
* Managing the consolidated middleware roadmap, prioritizing global reliability frameworks (like cross\-zone replication/caching), and tracking integration unit economics (e.g., standardizing integration cost per application).



  





**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS:** 




**Must\-Have** 



* Solid experience as a Product Manager (or Product Owner acting as PM) in:
* Data platforms, data engineering, analytics platforms, or developer/platform tools, or
* Technical products with strong infrastructure or backend components.
* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Data, or equivalent experience). You don't need to code daily, but you must:
* Be comfortable discussing architecture, pipelines, and technical trade\-offs with engineers.
* Understand concepts like data pipelines, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data lakes, data warehouses, and APIs.
* Broaden the technical scope to include API management, event\-driven architectures, and microservices alongside the existing data pipeline concepts.



  





**Strong skills in:** 



* Product discovery and problem framing.
* Prioritization and roadmap management.
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, negotiate priorities, and align diverse interests.
* Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken).



  





**Nice\-to\-Have (Differentials)** 



* Experience with some of the technologies and concepts we use is a big plus, but not mandatory:
* Cloud \& Data: Azure, Databricks, Apache Spark, Airflow, Unity Catalog.
* Engineering Practices: GitHub, CI/CD, code review flows, Data Mesh.
* Experience with internal platforms or "products for developers/data teams" is especially valuable.
* Explicitly call out experience with legacy\-to\-cloud migrations (e.g., MuleSoft to Camel\-K), Azure DevOps for delivery tracking, and deep observability tools like Datadog.



  





*And above all of this, an undying love for beer!* 




*We dream big to create future with more cheers*

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Search
jobs.description:
**Principal Product Manager – Beauty Search** 




  





**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Team:** 
 Product – Nykaa Beauty
 








**Company Overview** 




 Nykaa is India's leading beauty and lifestyle destination, operating on an omnichannel model with a strong online presence and an expanding network of retail stores. We offer a comprehensive selection of beauty, skincare, hair care, wellness, and fashion products, catering to millions of customers across the country. Nykaa is committed to providing a curated, personalized, and seamless shopping experience through cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven insights.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a Principal Product Manager – Search at Nykaa, you will own the end\-to\-end search experience across our app and web platforms. This is not a UI/UX\-only role — you are a product builder who will redefine how millions of users discover beauty and lifestyle products through intelligent, AI\-first search. You will work at the intersection of information retrieval, natural language understanding, and machine learning to build search experiences that are fast, relevant, and increasingly personalized. You will partner closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Design teams to ship high\-impact features and continually raise the bar on search quality and innovation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Own and Elevate the Core Search Experience** 




 • Define and drive the product roadmap for search — spanning query understanding, spell correction, synonym handling, ranking, and results relevance.
 



 • Move beyond keyword matching to build intent\-aware search using NLP and semantic understanding to surface the right products at the right moment.
 



 • Own core search KPIs including search conversion rate, zero\-result rate, click\-through rate, and post\-search funnel metrics.
 



**2\. Build AI\-First Search Features** 




 • Identify and launch AI\-native features such as conversational search (LLM\-powered), and generative product recommendations triggered from search intent.
 



 • Partner with Data Science teams to build, evaluate, and iterate on ML models — including learning\-to\-rank, query classification, and personalized re\-ranking.
 



 • Leverage LLMs and foundation models to prototype and ship new search experiences at speed — from auto\-complete enhancements to AI\-generated search summaries.
 



**3\. Experimentation and Data\-Driven Iteration** 




 • Design and run a rigorous A/B testing pipeline to validate ranking changes, UI treatments, and new feature hypotheses before full rollout.
 



 • Analyze search logs, query patterns, and behavioral data to uncover friction points and improvement opportunities across the search funnel.
 



**4\. Cross\-functional Execution** 




 • Write detailed PRDs and technical specs that translate business goals into clear model requirements and engineering deliverables.
 



 • Collaborate with Category, Merchandising, and Marketing teams to ensure product catalog quality and tagging support strong search outcomes.
 



 • Stay current on global search and AI trends — benchmark against leading e\-commerce and AI\-native search experiences to continuously raise the bar.
 



  





**Required Skillset** 




 • Academic Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree , preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
 



 • Experience: At least 7 years of product management experience in consumer internet or e\-commerce, with direct ownership of search, discovery, or AI/ML\-powered features.
 



 • Technical Fluency: Comfortable working with Data Science and Engineering teams. Able to meaningfully discuss query understanding, ranking models, embeddings, precision/recall trade\-offs, and API design.
 



 • AI Familiarity: Working knowledge of modern AI/ML techniques relevant to search — including NLP, vector search, semantic retrieval, LLMs, and personalization signals.
 



 • Analytical Depth: Strong command of data — able to define success metrics, interpret A/B test results, and use behavioral analytics to drive prioritization.
 



 • Product Thinking: Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into simple, delightful user experiences that drive measurable business outcomes.
 



 • Communication: Able to bridge technical complexity and business strategy, keeping engineering, design, and business stakeholders aligned.
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 • Prior experience with search platforms, recommendation systems, or catalog quality tooling.
 



 • Exposure to LLM\-based product development, prompt engineering, or AI product prototyping.
 



 • Familiarity with beauty, fashion, or lifestyle e\-commerce and the nuances of catalog\-driven search.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 Nykaa Beauty is India's largest and most loved beauty e\-commerce destination. You'll join a high\-ownership, high\-impact product team building search experiences used by millions of customers every day. This role gives you the canvas to build AI\-first features at scale — at a company where search is a core growth lever.

**About the Role**

**What You’ll Do** 






 •
 

 Own and maintain the product and feature roadmap; turn business needs into clear specs and user stories
 





 •
 

 Prioritise features and manage the backlog with stakeholders.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Review pull requests for standards and compliance — tests present, conventions followed, tickets linked — and route issues back to developers.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Plan and manage the test cycle — test plans, regression, and UAT.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Coordinate and own go\-lives and releases, including checklists and rollback readiness.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Work closely with developers, QA, and business stakeholders to keep delivery on track.
 
  
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 






 •
 
**4\-5 years in a product, delivery, with enough technical background to read code and judge whether a change meets standards.** 






 •
 

 Experience owning a product or feature roadmap: requirements, prioritisation, and specs.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Experience reviewing work for quality and compliance (PRs, test coverage, standards).
 
  
 




 •
 

 Experience planning and managing a testing / QA cycle.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Experience managing releases and go\-lives, including rollback planning.
 
  
 




 •
 

 Strong communication and coordination across developers, QA, and business.
 
  
 



  





**This Role Is Not a Fit If…** 






 •
 

 You are a pure project manager with no ability to read code or judge technical quality.
 
  
 




 •
 

 You have never owned a roadmap, a test cycle, or a release.
 
  
 




 •
 

 You need someone else to make every call on scope, quality, and go / no\-go.
 
  
 



  





**Nice to Have**

 Familiarity with our stack (Angular, Python, AWS).

 Agile / Scrum experience.

 Fluency with tools like Jira and GitHub pull requests.

 A past hands\-on engineering or QA background you can point to.

**Overview**
**Product Owner**
**BASIC SUMMARY:**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and execution\-focused Product Owner to support the delivery of features and enhancements within our healthcare claims administration platform. This role is responsible for translating business and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable user stories and working closely with engineering teams to ensure timely , high\-quality delivery. The ideal candidate brings healthcare domain knowledge, understands Agile processes, and is comfortable using AI\-enabled tools to support requirements definition and backlog management.

* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring stories are well\-defined, prioritized, and aligned with sprint goals
* Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and customer\-centric
* Conduct regular backlog grooming and sprint planning in collaboration with the Scrum team
* Participate in daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as an active team member
* Ensure user stories meet the definition of ready and done before development and release


**Requirements Gathering \& User Story Development**
* Collaborate with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to gather and refine product requirements
* Use AI tools (where applicable) to support the creation of epics, themes, and user stories
* Conduct gap analysis and validation of requirements to ensure completeness and feasibility
* Support refinement of use cases, workflows, and functional documentation


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for development teams during sprint execution
* Partner with UX/UI designers to ensure user stories are aligned with design principles and usability goals
* Support QA teams by clarifying acceptance criteria and reviewing test cases as needed
* Coordinate with other Product Owners to manage interdependencies between features


**Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Participate in stakeholder meetings to capture feature requests, enhancement ideas, and feedback
* Communicate updates to internal stakeholders on backlog priorities, delivery timelines, and sprint progress
* Help ensure features delivered meet customer needs and stakeholder expectations


**Healthcare Domain Support**
* Apply working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, billing terminology, and reimbursement processes
* Support compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) in collaboration with internal teams
* Assist in translating complex healthcare requirements into understandable product features


**Minimum Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business , Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2\+ years of product management experience ; healthcare technology or claims administration preferred
* 2\+ years of experience working with AI tools for product development, requirements engineering, or business analysis preferred
* Familiarity with Agile software development and Scrum methodology
* Proficiency with Jira (or similar Agile tools) for backlog management
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools to help structure requirements and analyze user input (preferred but not required )
* Basic understanding of software development processes and technical constraints
* Familiarity with collaboration tools (e.g., Confluence, Miro, Figma)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying requirements and feedback
* High attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable working with cross\-functional teams and resolving blockers quickly


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification
* Understanding of healthcare data standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, X12 EDI)

 Trintech is an award\-winning AI\-driven FinTech SaaS company transforming how organisations automate their financial close. We're looking for a Senior Product Owner to join our AI Platform team. This is a strategic platform role focused on the shared capabilities that power every AI agent across our products.
   

  

 As our AI ecosystem grows, this role will ensure the platform remains consistent, scalable and easy for product teams to build on. You'll own the platform capability roadmap and API contract, working closely with Product Owners, Engineering and the Platform Architect to prioritise platform investments, govern shared capabilities and prevent platform fragmentation.
   

  

 While the platform is currently internal, our long\-term vision is to evolve it into a customer\-facing platform where users can configure, orchestrate and interact with multiple AI agents. The decisions you make today will help shape that future.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Own the Platform
   

  

* Own the platform capability roadmap, defining what capabilities the platform exposes and how they evolve.
* Maintain and govern the platform API contract, ensuring it remains the single source of truth for APIs, event schemas and shared capabilities.
* Define platform standards that create a consistent experience across all AI agents.


 Drive Cross\-Team Alignment
   

  

* Partner with Product Owners across multiple AI squads to understand platform needs and prioritise shared capabilities.
* Consolidate similar requests into reusable platform solutions rather than one\-off features.
* Challenge requirements that could create inconsistency or unnecessary complexity across the platform.
* Identify emerging platform needs and proactively shape future capabilities.


 Collaborate Across the Business
   

  

* Work closely with the Platform Architect and Engineering Manager to balance product priorities with technical strategy.
* Communicate roadmap priorities, sequencing and platform decisions to stakeholders.
* Ensure platform investments support both immediate delivery needs and the long\-term product vision.


**What You'll Have**
* 8\+ years' experience as a Product Owner or similar product role.
* Experience delivering enterprise SaaS products, platforms or developer\-facing capabilities.
* Proven experience managing product roadmaps and prioritising work across multiple teams.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, event\-driven systems and platform architecture with engineering teams.


 Bonus points for
   

  

* Experience owning a platform, infrastructure or API product.
* Exposure to AI products, machine learning or agentic platforms.
* Azure or cloud platform experience.
* Financial software, Office of the CFO or Record\-to\-Report domain knowledge.
* Experience with Product\-Led Growth (PLG) or self\-service products.


**Why Join Trintech?**
 This is a rare opportunity to shape the foundation of Trintech's AI strategy. You'll influence the platform that every AI team builds upon while helping evolve it from internal infrastructure into a customer\-facing multi\-agent platform. Working alongside Product, Engineering and Architecture leaders, you'll have a direct impact on how AI capabilities are delivered today—and how customers experience them in the future.
   

  

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

jobs.title: Analyst – Master Data Management
jobs.description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**


We are looking for **Analyst – Master Data Management** and who play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of vendor master data that supports critical procurement and finance operations.  

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive professional with **4\+years of experience** in Vendor Master Data Management and Supplier Onboarding. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with **Zycus** and **Infor**, a strong understanding of data governance, supplier compliance, and banking validation processes, and a passion for maintaining high\-quality master data.

#### **What you will do**

* Manage the end\-to\-end supplier onboarding process from **Zycus** to **Infor Supplier Master**.
* Create, validate, approve, and maintain supplier master records while ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* Review and verify supplier documentation, including tax forms, banking details, business registrations, certifications, and compliance documents in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Perform independent verification of supplier banking information to ensure authenticity, accuracy, and compliance before vendor setup and payment processing.
* Execute vendor master data cleansing activities between **Infor** and **Zycus** to support accurate and seamless data migration.
* Monitor and maintain vendor master data integrity by identifying and resolving data quality issues.
* Develop, update, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and work instructions related to supplier onboarding and vendor master management.
* Collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Compliance, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure efficient supplier onboarding and ongoing master data governance.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, data governance standards, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Support continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance data quality and operational efficiency.

#### **What you bring**

*Experience*

* 4\+ years of experience in Vendor Master Data Management, Supplier Onboarding, or Master Data Management.
* Hands\-on experience working with **Zycus**, **Infor Supplier Master**, or similar ERP and supplier management platforms.
* Strong knowledge of supplier onboarding processes, vendor master maintenance, and data governance.
* Experience in banking validation, supplier documentation review, and compliance verification.
* Exposure to data cleansing, data migration, and master data quality initiatives.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP reporting tools is an advantage.

*Personal competencies*

* Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Process\-oriented with a focus on accuracy and continuous improvement.

#### **Who we are**

**At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.**

**Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.**

**With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.**

**Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**

 *WSA is an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.*

**Job Description:**  

Description
  
  

Seeking a passionate, handson technical AI /ML engineer to join our growing team and solve exciting engineering problems in semiconductor space. The nature of problems are wide ranging giving an opportunity to grow continuously. This position will work closely with multidisciplinary team, product managers, Data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to bring AI solutions to production
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Design and Develop ML Models for high impact engineering solutions. Build, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models to solve complex problems using natural language processing, computer vision, and predictive analytics. Knowledge of python, Pytorch, agentic frameworks, Langchain, RAG, capability to understand and build deep learning models on cloud or on premises compute.
  
**Data Collection and Preprocessing:** Python preprocessing for structured and unstructured data \[numeric, images, videos and documents)
  
**Feature Engineering:** Identify, extract, and transform relevant features from raw data to improve model performance and interpretability.
  
**Model Evaluation and monitoring:** Assess model accuracy and robustness using statistical metrics and validation techniques.
  
**Deployment and Integration:** Knowledge of Kubernetes, Flask, Ray Serve, Azure Devops, ONNX, or cloud\-based solutions. .
  
**Research and Innovation:** Stay abreast of the latest developments in AI/ML research and technologies. Experiment with new algorithms, tools, and frameworks to drive innovation and maintain a competitive edge.
  
**Documentation and Reporting:** Create comprehensive documentation of model architecture, data sources, training processes, and evaluation metrics. Present findings and recommendations to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
  
**Ethics and Compliance:** Uphold ethical standards and ensure compliance with regulations governing data privacy, security, and responsible AI deployment.
  
Required Experience and Skills
  
  

**Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field. 3\+ years of professional experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence, or related fields. A PhD or relevant research experience would be a plus.
  
Hands\-on experience with neural networks, deep learning, and architectures such as CNNs, RNNs, Transformers and Generative AI.
  
**Exposure to MLOps practices:** monitoring, scaling, and automating ML workflows
  
**Experience with big data platforms:** Databricks, Hadoop, Spark, Dataflow, etc.
  
Familiarity with advanced topics such as reinforcement learning, generative models, or explainable AI
  
Desired Experience and Skills
  
  

Proficiency in programming languages such as Python (preferred), Java, Csharp, or C\+\+
  
**Deep understanding of machine learning frameworks:** PyTorch, scikit\-learn, Keras, etc.
  
**Experience with data manipulation tools:** NumPy, SQL, Pandas
  
Solid grasp of statistics, probability theory, and linear algebra
  
**Familiarity with cloud and Data computing platforms:** Azure, Azure DevOps, DataBricks GCP
  
**Knowledge of containerization and orchestration:** Docker, Kubernetes
  
Experience in deploying machine learning models to production
  
**Understanding of software engineering best practices:** version control (Git), unit testing, CI/CD pipelines
